headline: Result Update

highlights: Important Data • During Q2FY27, Sai Life Sciences reported strong revenue growth of 23% YoY to ₹659crs, compared with ₹537crs in Q2FY26, supported by healthy performance across both CRO and CDMO businesses.
EBITDA increased 28% YoY to ₹186crs, with EBITDA margin improving to 28% from 27% in Q2FY26.
Reported PAT increased 17% YoY to ₹98crs, with PAT margin at 15%.
Growth in CRO is driven by deeper outsourcing from existing customers and increasing large pharma relationships.
valuation: Management highlighted that integrated engagements across multiple services and products help mitigate customer concentration risk.

Management remains confident of achieving its long-term revenue growth and EBITDA targets. • We expect Sai Life Sciences to deliver revenue and EBITDA CAGR of 12% each over FY26–FY28E, while PAT is projected to grow at 15%, supported by sustained growth in CRO and CDMO businesses, increasing large pharma outsourcing opportunities and gradual contribution from capacity expansion.

The company's integrated CRDMO platform, established relationships with 19 of the top 25 global pharma companies, healthy commercial pipeline and investments in newer modalities provide strong long-term growth visibility. • At the current market price, the stock trades at 86x FY28E P/E and 43x FY28E EV/EBITDA, compared with its three-year average multiples of 79x and 36x, respectively, indicating premium valuations.
watch: Management highlighted that integrated engagements across multiple services and products help mitigate customer concentration risk.
This material contains statements that are forward-looking; such statements are based upon the current beliefs and expectations and are subject to significant risks and uncertainties.
